skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

skills.name: karpathy-guidelines
skills.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Use test-driven development for behavior-changing feature or fix work, and whenever the user mentions TDD, test-first, red-green-refactor, tracer bullets, integration tests, or public-interface behavior tests. Skip for docs-only, path-only rename, formatting-only, or purely mechanical chores unless explicitly requested.
skills.compatibility: Requires bun for Plaited repository validation

skills.name: you-discover
skills.description: Route You.com integration planning through the you-discover MCP tool, Docs MCP, and direct API options.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access. Prefer the standard You.com MCP server exposing `you-discover` and Docs MCP `searchDocs`.

skills.name: you-finance
skills.description: Route finance questions to an existing local script, a new You.com Finance Research API call, or an MCP payment-aware fallback.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access and either the You.com Finance Research API with `YDC_API_KEY` or MPP/x402 payment support, or a You.com MCP client that can tolerate long finance responses and keyless MPP/x402 payment challenges.

skills.name: you-free
skills.description: Use the free You.com MCP profile for unauthenticated basic web search with `you-search` only.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access and the You.com free MCP profile exposing `you-search`. Does not require `YDC_API_KEY` or OAuth.

skills.name: you-research
skills.description: Route research tasks between a cost-conscious agentic search workflow, You.com Research API scripts, and managed or payment-aware MCP fallback.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access and either You.com MCP tools with `YDC_API_KEY`, OAuth, or payment support, or the You.com Research API with `YDC_API_KEY` or an MPP/x402-capable client.

skills.name: you-web
skills.description: Use You.com MCP tools for current web search, URL content extraction, cited web synthesis, and x402-aware web access.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access and a You.com MCP server exposing `you-search`, `you-contents`, and `you-research`; use `YDC_API_KEY`, OAuth, or an x402-aware client for paid/keyless search and contents retries.
